scenes.title: Your Cells
scenes.text: Your body holds around thirty seven trillion cells, each one a tiny living factory working for you.

scenes.title: Heartbeats
scenes.text: Your heart beats about sixty thousand times a day, pumping blood without ever asking for a break.

scenes.title: Hair
scenes.text: You lose about one hundred strands of hair every single day, and grow nearly all of them back.

scenes.title: Bones
scenes.text: Babies start with around three hundred bones. Adults have two hundred and six after some fuse together.

scenes.title: New Skin
scenes.text: Your skin completely renews itself about every two weeks, replacing the outer layer you see today.

scenes.title: Change
scenes.text: Most cells in your body are replaced every few years. You are not the same person you were.

scenes.title: Water
scenes.text: You are mostly water. Lose just two percent of it and your focus and mood start to drop.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: Your body is a miracle you live inside every day. Which fact surprised you the most today?
